description:
Wire ExtensionRunner hooks into the agent loop for the core LLM and tool lifecycle.

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts lines 599-877.

Depends on: ExtensionRunner ticket.

## Hooks to implement

For each hook, if state.extension_runner is nil: skip the emit (no-op; sessions
without extensions work exactly as before).

### :context — before LLM call (result-modifiable)

Payload: %{messages: [Message.t()]}
Allowed result: {:ok, %{messages: modified_messages}}
Wire in loop.ex stream_turn/3, AFTER calling SessionManager.build_session_context/1
and BEFORE building %AIContext{}:
  case Session.emit_hook(session, :context, %{messages: session_ctx.messages}) do
    {:modified, %{messages: m}} -> use m as the messages list
    _ -> use session_ctx.messages unchanged
  end

### :before_agent_start — before first turn (result-modifiable)

Payload: %{session_manager: sm}
Allowed result: {:ok, %{prepend_message: Message.t()}} — inject a message before the run
Wire in loop.ex run/1 after dispatching AgentStart event.

### Notification-only hooks (emit, ignore return value)

:agent_start   — fire alongside existing AgentStart event in loop.ex run/1
:agent_end     — fire alongside existing AgentEnd event in loop.ex run/1
:turn_start    — fire alongside existing TurnStart event in loop.ex loop/6
:turn_end      — fire alongside existing TurnEnd event in loop.ex loop/6
:message_start — fire alongside existing MessageStart in handle_ai_event
:message_end   — fire alongside existing MessageEnd in handle_ai_event

### :tool_call — before tool executes (cancellable + result-modifiable)

Payload: %{tool_call_id: id, tool_name: name, args: map()}
Allowed results:
  {:cancel, reason}              — block the call; produce an error ToolResult
  {:ok, %{args: modified_args}}  — mutate arguments before the handler sees them
Wire in loop.ex dispatch_with_hooks/5 BEFORE the existing run_before_hook/2 check.
This replaces the before_tool_call function hook in Session.State for the extension
path — keep before_tool_call working for non-extension callers (it runs after the
extension check).

### :tool_result — after tool executes (result-modifiable)

Payload: %{tool_call_id: id, tool_name: name, result: Tool.Result.t()}
Allowed result: {:ok, %{result: modified_result}}
Wire in loop.ex run_tool_handler/4 AFTER the result is obtained, before returning.

### :input — when user message arrives (cancellable + result-modifiable)

Payload: %{text: String.t(), images: [ImageContent.t()]}
Allowed results:
  {:cancel, reason}             — discard the input silently
  {:ok, %{text: new_text}}      — transform the text
Wire in session.ex prompt/2 handler before building the User message.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/extension_hooks_test.exs.
  - :context hook modifying messages changes what the transport receives
  - :tool_call cancel hook produces an error ToolResult without calling the handler
  - :tool_call args modification is seen by the handler
  - :tool_result modification changes the ToolResult appended to session_manager
  - :input cancel discards the prompt
  - all hooks are skipped gracefully when extension_runner is nil
